title: Milwaukee’s Chourio’s 18 RBI set the before-23 postseason record.
intro: Jackson Chourio · Milwaukee Brewers; Andruw Jones · Atlanta Braves. Postseason before age 23.
conclusion: Chourio’s 18 RBI set the before-23 postseason record. Jones: 17 RBI · 128 at-bats; Chourio: 18 RBI · 74 at-bats
methodology: Chourio through October 14, 2026; Jones, 1996–1999. At-bats provide context, not equal RBI opportunities.
RBI and at-bats are distinct counts, not components of a whole. Jones 17 RBI / 128 AB; Chourio 18 RBI / 74 AB. No hit or RBI percentage is plotted or asserted.
Chourio 2024–2026 through October 14; Jones 1996–1999, before his 23rd birthday. MLB reports the record, official year-by-year statistics reproduce the counts.
